## Code Review

This pull request introduces a trace definition and a reference test for the `fused_add_rmsnorm` operation with a hidden size of 3584, targeting Qwen2.5-7B. The documentation is also updated to reflect the implementation status. Feedback highlights that the `fused_add_rmsnorm` kernel modifies both the input and residual tensors in-place. Consequently, the JSON definition should be updated to include the modified residual in its outputs, and both the reference implementation and the test script should be expanded to verify that the residual tensor is correctly updated.
